decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8935. Series context: trend strength 0.8552 and seasonal strength 0.3795; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.103); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.635.
